story_note: Phil greets the new morning puzzle with his usual quiet focus, immediately sensing a subtle shift in the clues that calls for fresh patience and steady reasoning.
continuation_note: Having unlocked a tricky column, Phil feels the steady momentum building and looks forward to returning tomorrow for the puzzle's satisfying conclusion.

scenes.title: Back Again
scenes.beat: Return after yesterday, new daily puzzle, same habit
scenes.caption: Phil pours his tea, ready to begin.

scenes.title: Different Start
scenes.beat: The first move shows today's puzzle is different
scenes.dialogue: Hmm, this first clue feels unfamiliar.
scenes.caption: A subtle twist marks today’s start.

scenes.title: The Pushback
scenes.beat: A fair stuck moment, no guessing
scenes.dialogue: No guessing – better to think this through.
scenes.caption: Phil pauses, weighing his options.

scenes.title: The Column
scenes.dialogue: That column just snapped into place!
scenes.caption: A breakthrough lights the way forward.

scenes.title: The Follow-Through
scenes.dialogue: Now the answers begin to flow.
scenes.caption: Phil steadily fills out the grid.

scenes.title: Worth Returning For
scenes.beat: Completion or honest latest progress, return tomorrow
scenes.caption: Progress made; a return visit is planned.
